IPA/APK Upload API - LLM Integration Guide

Purpose
- Upload .ipa or .apk files with token auth.
- For .ipa uploads, automatically generate iOS OTA manifest + install links.
- For .apk uploads, generate a public Android install page + direct APK URL.

Base URL
- Use your deployed API base URL, e.g. https://api.example.com
- Health endpoint: GET /health

Auth
- Header required on protected endpoints:
  Authorization: Bearer <API_TOKEN>

Environment Requirements
- API_TOKEN: required secret token.
- PUBLIC_BASE_URL: required; must be HTTPS and reachable by devices.
- Files are served from /uploads/*.
- Optional Slack notifications:
  - SLACK_BOT_TOKEN: Slack Bot token (xoxb-...)
  - SLACK_CHANNEL_ID: Slack channel id
  - When both are set, new builds are posted to Slack
  - If Slack returns an error, upload fails with 502.

Endpoints

1) GET /health
- Auth: none
- Response 200:
  { "ok": true }

2) POST /upload
- Auth: required
- Content-Type: multipart/form-data
- Form field: file
- Optional form field: summary (string)
- Allowed extensions: .ipa, .apk

Success Responses

A) .ipa upload (201)
{
  "message": "Upload successful",
  "filename": "MyApp-1716976800000.ipa",
  "originalName": "MyApp.ipa",
  "size": 12345678,
  "ipaUrl": "https://downloads.example.com/uploads/MyApp-1716976800000.ipa",
  "manifestUrl": "https://downloads.example.com/uploads/MyApp-1716976800000-manifest.plist",
  "installUrl": "itms-services://?action=download-manifest&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdownloads.example.com%2Fuploads%2FMyApp-1716976800000-manifest.plist",
  "installPageUrl": "https://downloads.example.com/uploads/MyApp-1716976800000-install.html",
  "summary": "QA approved build",
  "bundleIdentifier": "com.example.myapp",
  "version": "1.2.3",
  "buildNumber": "42",
  "title": "My App"
}

B) .apk upload (201)
{
  "message": "Upload successful",
  "filename": "android-release-1716976800000.apk",
  "originalName": "android-release.apk",
  "size": 7654321,
  "apkUrl": "https://downloads.example.com/uploads/android-release-1716976800000.apk",
  "installPageUrl": "https://downloads.example.com/uploads/android-release-1716976800000-install.html",
  "summary": "Android build for testers",
  "title": "android-release"
}

Error Responses
- Common shape:
  { "error": "<message>" }

- 401 Unauthorized:
  - Missing or invalid bearer token.

- 502 Bad Gateway examples:
  - Slack notification failed: network error.
  - Slack notification failed: invalid Slack response.
  - Slack notification failed: <slack_error>.

- 400 Bad Request examples:
  - Missing file field (use "file").
  - Only .ipa and .apk files are allowed.
  - Invalid IPA file: failed to read archive.
  - Invalid IPA file: Info.plist not found under Payload/*.app/.
  - Invalid IPA file: Info.plist is empty.
  - IPA metadata incomplete: ... required.
  - Generated manifest plist validation failed.
  - IPA URL must use HTTPS.
  - APK URL must use HTTPS.
  - Manifest URL must use HTTPS.
  - Install page URL must use HTTPS.

Agent Usage Pattern
1) Call POST /upload with bearer token and file.
2) Prefer `installPageUrl` as primary user action URL.
3) For iOS, keep `installUrl` as deep-link fallback.
4) Pass `summary` when available for audit context.
5) On errors, surface server message directly to user.
6) Do not ask users for iOS bundle identifier/version when uploading IPA; server extracts it.
